invariants.rationale: The method collects a Stream into a List, which is never null.
The method calls data.stream(), which would throw NullPointerException if data were null.
List.size() is always non-negative for java.util.List.
If func maps each input to at least one output, the result size will be at least data.size(); if data is empty or func returns empty streams, result may be empty.
If data is empty, the result must be empty as there are no elements to process.
